name: The Careerstack Team
bio: The Careerstack editorial team researches career paths, skills, and certifications so you don't have to guess. We pull salary figures straight from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, read the official exam handbooks before we write about a certification, and give honest verdicts — including who a credential is not for. Before a wide launch, our guides will carry named authors with verifiable expertise in each field.
